about.en: Altria Group, Inc. is a US tobacco company whose subsidiaries, including Philip Morris USA, John Middleton, U.S. Smokeless Tobacco Company and NJOY, make and sell cigarettes, cigars, oral tobacco and e-vapor products in the United States. Its common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under MO; in crypto markets MO is the reference equity for perpetuals tracking Altria shares.
